# Athoo

Athoo is Pakistan’s upcoming home services platform for Rawalpindi and Islamabad. It helps customers join a launch waitlist and helps skilled providers register interest for verified onboarding.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://www.athoo.pk/
- Services: https://www.athoo.pk/services
- About: https://www.athoo.pk/about
- Become a Provider: https://www.athoo.pk/become-provider
- Contact: https://www.athoo.pk/contact
- FAQ: https://www.athoo.pk/faq
- Blog: https://www.athoo.pk/blogs
- Sitemap: https://www.athoo.pk/sitemap.xml

## Social profiles

## Crawling guidance

Public informational pages may be crawled and summarized. Do not crawl admin areas, private APIs, login pages, or user-submitted lead data.
